newsitem.title: POLAND: Poles change 4.7 mln NFI units to shares.
newsitem.headline: Poles change 4.7 mln NFI units to shares.

text.p: Poles have so far exchanged 4,739,208 units in Poland's National Investment Fund (NFI) mass privatisation scheme for shares in the 15 funds, the National Securities Depository (KDPW) said on Monday.

Since May 12, holders of 25.6 million units have been eligible to exchange their unit into 15 shares, one in each fund. The funds entered the bourse's main market on June 12. Each NFI has 31,026,185 shares.
A KDPW official told Reuters that by Monday, 14.97 million of the units had been converted into book-entry form, a step necessary for bourse trade.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to the funds, run by foreign and domestic management firms.
